Find a comfortable position, sitting or lying down. Let your eyes close, or rest your gaze softly on the floor.
[pause 48]
[repeat 3]
[in 4] Breathe in
[out 6] And out, slowly
[/repeat]
Today's practice: small steps.
[pause 47]
Picture one small step that would build your confidence, something only a little uncomfortable.
[pause 51]
Imagine yourself taking it calmly, breathing slowly.
[pause 51]
Notice the anxiety rise a little, and then settle.
[pause 51]
Each small step teaches your brain that you can cope.
[pause 51]
Take a slow breath, and notice how you feel now compared with when you started.
[pause 50]
Confidence grows with practice, not perfection.
Take a moment to thank yourself for this time. Then, in your own time, open your eyes.
[chime]
